text: Personally, I don't understand why you have to double down on the free version of the app with a bunch of ads AND limited song choices. That's overkill and it makes this app hardly even usable for longer than 20 minutes before it devolves into music that's vaguely related to the stuff you chose to listen to. It's great when you spend money, but that's by design. Y'all make enough money to give us more than 6 skips... I mean, c'mon.

I love music, it's the only thing that keeps me focused on things like drawing, love Spotify, I COULD listen outside of the app and for the last few months of what I expected was just a bug that now constantly happens whenever I leave the app to go to anything else, it closes and turns my music off, back when I'd have said five stars, maybe lower the price instead of increasing an extra dollar every year for premium, and FIVE ads? Thats unnecessary, two or three is fine, but five hits my anger.
replyText: Hi. We'll pass this on to the ads team. Furthermore, have you tried a quick reinstall? If that doesn't help, you should give our Customer Service a shout by heading to support.spotify.com and searching "Contact us".

text: So they finally gave the option to disable smart shuffle, I can rate Spotify more than 1 star now. Always loved Spotify, and just hated that smart shuffle. It would be amazing if y'all could add a way to let us know when a song is removed from a playlist. I just recently went through and noticed multiple songs that weren't there anymore. Assumably due to them being removed off Spotify. If there was something that showed us what songs got removed, we could easily look for a replacement.

Shuffle does not actually shuffle. 'Shuffle' is just Spotify's version of a playlist. If I add a song to the queue, it'll play the song but will not change the shuffle, so that song could be played right away again if it was in that order of the 'shuffle'. Super annoying, especially considering the monthly price keeps going up, but the issue doesn't get resolved! Also, my app keeps skipping! Makes me feel like I'm back in the 90's and I need to take the CD out and wipe it off! it's not my settin

Free version is almost unusable. Good grief! 4 ads in a row then it tells me I can enjoy 30 minutes ad free. 2 songs later here are 4 more ads. At first I figured maybe a weird glitch. Nope. It's happens several times over the last few days. And on top of the that the ads are horrible. They're louder than your music so it's very jarring especially if you're listening to something chill, and they're repetitive. I can't listen to specific songs, everything is behind a pay wall now.

replyText: Hi. Thanks for sharing this. We hear you and we'll pass your feedback along to the Ads team. For an ad-free experience, we'd recommend checking out our Premium plans at spotify.com/premium. If you've never had Premium before, you should be eligible for our trial.

My issue with Spotify is how poorly they support the artists creating the music their entire platform depends on. As an artist, my experience with Spotify's artist support has been frustrating and disappointing. When something goes wrong or you need meaningful answers, getting real assistance feels nearly impossible. If you truly love music, don't just support the songs you love... support the people creating them. Consider choosing a streaming service that treats artists fairly
